svg.text: Two levels: the folders, and the files that carry the logic.

svg.text: mqtt_link, gpio_manager, node_control, node_health: the broker side
web_server, api_shared, node_store, tls_cert: panel and settings
network, board_ethernet, ble_provision, github_update: link and updates
core/: the logic with no ESP-IDF, tested on a computer
